cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Look at that sunset, Lark. Almost makes me glad we took the long way.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: I'll tell the tower you were late for artistic reasons. Watch that ridge.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Sun's coming up. You smell coffee, Lark?

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Hot wiring insulation, Captain. I admire your optimism.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Oh, nice! Looks like we got here in the middle of the day. This should be easy!

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Beautiful visibility. I'm sure the gun crews appreciate it just as much as you do.

cues.speaker: vale
cues.text: Uh-oh. It's pitch black outside! How are we supposed to see anything?

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: I guess you should have bought the headlight upgrade instead of spending all that time in the cantina last night.

cues.speaker: lark
cues.text: Headlight's on, Captain. That bright patch ahead? That's where I'd fly.
